author: Animan
description:
Top 10 Most Tortured Anime Characters of All Time — these are the anime characters who suffered more than anyone else. From endless death loops to eternal isolation, this ranking explores the most tragic and tortured anime characters ever written.
Some anime characters don't just face hardship — they're designed to suffer. In this video, we break down 10 of the most tortured, broken, and tragic anime characters of all time, including Hyakkimaru from Dororo, Ymir Fritz from Attack on Titan, Diavolo from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Yuji Itadori from Jujutsu Kaisen, and more. Each entry explores what makes their suffering uniquely devastating — physical pain, psychological torment, eternal loops, or losing themselves piece by piece.
If you love dark anime, tragic backstories, and characters whose stories stay with you long after the credits roll, this list is for you.

title: These Anime Characters Were BUILT To Suffer
